title.zh: Logic 工程能导出了、配对文件修好两处保真损失
title.en: A Logic project can be exported, and the paired files fixed two writing losses

highlights.zh: 乐谱页头部多了一个「导出 Logic 工程（.logicx.zip）」：写出的是 Logic 的工程目录结构，浏览器交给你一个包。
highlights.en: The score header carries Export Logic Project (.logicx.zip): it writes a Logic project structure, and the browser hands you one package.

highlights.zh: 同曲 MIDI 与 MusicXML 配对互校，逼出两处听不出来的保真损失并修好：非网格音长不再被取整、重叠音不再被顺延两拍。
highlights.en: Cross-checking the same piece in MIDI and MusicXML exposed two silent fidelity losses, now fixed: off-grid note lengths are no longer rounded and overlapping notes are no longer pushed two beats late.

highlights.zh: 导出条数是跟着菜单算出来的，所以多一个导出项时那句文案会自己更新——这次它从 7 变成 8。
highlights.en: The stated export count is derived from the menu, so it follows a new export by itself: this time it went from seven to eight.
